svg.title: Bytes to store a revision, given its parent
svg.desc: Dot plot from experiment E002: for four revision pairs, the bytes needed to store the revision given its parent, as a share of its raw tensor bytes, for zstd per tensor, best-case byte-chunk dedup, and the wvc delta. Sparse rank-1 edit: 78.2%, 0.66%, 0.030%. Synthetic rank-8 merge: 77.8%, 3.51%, 1.67%. Consecutive pretraining checkpoints: 58.0%, 58.0%, 33.6%. Dense fine-tune: 77.9%, 77.9%, 56.3%.
